entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: An ecumenopolis plane whose entire surface is a city, home to diverse sentient races and ten guilds.

entities.name: Ten Ravnican guilds
entities.description: Ten political factions each representing a combination of two colors, in a power struggle for ten thousand years.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The accord signed by the paruns ten millennia ago, ending active warfare between the guilds.

entities.name: Paruns
entities.description: The guild leaders who signed the Guildpact.

events.summary: Ten millennia ago the paruns sign the Guildpact, ending active warfare and ushering in peace.
events.quote: Ten millennia ago, the Guildpact was signed by the paruns

events.summary: On the eve of the Guildpact's ten thousandth anniversary a sinister force threatens the peace.
events.quote: a sinister force threatens the survival of that peace

relations.note: The guilds contend for power in Ravnica's city.
relations.quote: For ten thousand years, there has been a power struggle between the ten Ravnican guilds
